title: Adapting Qwen3 to Tajik from 0.6B to 8B: Lower Text Loss Did Not Mean Better Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.06062v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Small LoRA adapters trained on Tajik news and books lowered Qwen3's Tajik text loss at every size we tried, from 0.6B to 8B, by 0.60 to 1.45 nats per token, but none of them improved Tajik reading comprehension where it can be measured. On Belebele the 1.7B and 8B adapters left accuracy unchanged and the 4B adapter lowered it by 3.7 points; at 0.6B the score rose by 4.2 points but sits near chance and coincides with a change in which answer letter the model prefers, so we do not read it as understanding. At 8B, continued pretraining on about 375 million tokens of raw Tajik text was followed by a Belebele gain of 9.9 points. After a further supervised fine-tuning stage, our main model, e3, is 11.4 points above Qwen3-8B on Belebele; its English MMLU changed by -1.2 points, and a loss larger than 3.3 points is excluded. The same heavy recipe applied to Qwen3-0.6B-Base brought its text loss close to that of the 8B model after books-only pret

translated_title: 将 Qwen3 适配到塔吉克语：从 0.6B 到 8B——更低的文本损失并不意味着更好的理解能力
translated_abstract: 在塔吉克语新闻和书籍上训练的小型 LoRA 适配器，在我们尝试的从 0.6B 到 8B 的所有模型规模上，都降低了 Qwen3 的塔吉克语文本损失，每 token 降低 0.60 至 1.45 nats，但在可测量的地方，没有一个适配器提升了塔吉克语阅读理解能力。在 Belebele 基准上，1.7B 和 8B 适配器的准确率没有变化，而 4B 适配器的准确率下降了 3.7 个百分点；在 0.6B 时分数上升了 4.2 个百分点，但该分数接近随机猜测水平，且恰好伴随模型所偏好答案字母的改变，因此我们不将其视为理解能力的提升。在 8B 规模上，对约 3.75 亿 token 的原始塔吉克语文本进行继续预训练后，Belebele 提升了 9.9 个百分点。在进一步的监督微调阶段之后，我们的主模型 e3 在 Belebele 上比 Qwen3-8B 高出 11.4 个百分点；其英语 MMLU 变化为 -1.2 个百分点，且可排除大于 3.3 个百分点的下降。将同样的高强度训练方案应用于 Qwen3-0.6B-Base 后，其文本损失接近仅用书籍预训练的 8B 模型的水平……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 在塔吉克语上对 Qwen3（0.6B–8B）进行 LoRA 微调虽然降低了文本损失，却未能带来真正的阅读理解提升，只有约 3.75 亿 token 的大规模继续预训练加监督微调，才使主模型 e3 在 Belebele 上超越 Qwen3-8B 达 11.4 个百分点。
en_tdlr: LoRA adaptation of Qwen3 to Tajik lowered text loss across all sizes from 0.6B to 8B but did not improve reading comprehension; only continued pretraining on ~375M tokens followed by supervised fine-tuning gave the e3 model a real 11.4-point Belebele gain over Qwen3-8B.
